messages.subject: Possible error in micro_usa()
parts:
Hey Mike,

I tried to run micro_usa() at its default settings (so just micro_usa()) and it came out with an error:

Error in RNetCDF::open.nc(paste0(baseurl, "tmmn_1979_CurrentYear_CONUS.nc")) : 
  NetCDF: Not a valid data type or _FillValue type mismatch

I looked through the function code itself and it seems like the base url is directing to a place that doesn't exist anymore? That might be it, but I'm not sure. Figured I'd report it just in case.

Best
Adam

All the best,
Mike
